note: Plain Romanian word for a generic legal professional; missing from the curated ESCO alias set, which only had domain-qualified aliases (consilier juridic, avocat, ...). Without this, single-word "Jurist" queries were dominated by compound aliases like "jurist lingvist" and resolved to linguist instead of any legal-professional leaf.

Same gap as legal consultant's jurist seed: "jurist" is also colloquially used for the plain lawyer role in Romanian job postings. A second occurrence within the Legal professionals family is also required to clear occupation-family-token-relevance-artifact.ts's MIN_FAMILY_TOKEN_OCCURRENCES=2 anti-noise threshold, without which the family's relevance score for the token stays 0 and crushes the alias-ngram score to near zero even on an exact match.
